overview: A holiday park near Crantock, now part of Park Holidays UK, a short drive from both Crantock Beach and Holywell Bay. It offers caravan holidays, glamping and touring and camping pitches. Facilities include a heated outdoor pool, the Piskie Inn pub, a children's adventure playground and fishing lakes.
surfTripFit: It is near both Crantock and Holywell, so you have two surf beaches to choose from.
